notes.blind_phase: Blind list from NPWF July 2026 chart (19 jurisdictions incl. DC and VA 2027), Wikipedia table, ABB list, law-firm/state pages; built before opening research states. Same 18 adopters and years as research. Caveat: the researcher also used NPWF/ABB, so agreement is not fully independent; I therefore re-opened primary or law-firm pages for DC, MD, MI, NE, AK, CO, MO, VA.

known_doubts_settled.DC_vs_CT: DC counts (51-unit panel): ASSLA 2008, employer duties from 2008-11-13; CT 2012 is the first STATE. Kept DC 2008.
known_doubts_settled.MI: Kept 2019: Paid Medical Leave Act (PA 369 of 2018, eff 2019-03-29, 50+ employers) was a paid sick leave mandate until ESTA reinstated 2025-02-21 (NPWF/ABB show only 2025). Definitional call; alternative 2025 recorded in note, confidence medium.
known_doubts_settled.NY: Kept 2020 (law effective 2020-09-30, accrual began); leave usable from 2021-01-01; alternative 2021 in note.
known_doubts_settled.MO: Excluded: Prop A leave 2025-05-01 to 2025-08-27, repealed by HB 567 (signed 2025-07-10); nothing in force at as-of.
known_doubts_settled.ME_NV_IL: Excluded: NPWF lists them as any-purpose PTO laws (ME 1/2021, NV 1/2020, IL 1/2024), not paid sick days.
known_doubts_settled.CO: 2021 kept: accrual from 2021-01-01 for 16+ employers (all employers 2022); 2020 provisions were COVID public-health-emergency leave.

notes.search_budget: WebSearch budget ran out during the TNC blind phase; PSL checks were completed before that.
